i have a lot to say about these ads but holy fucking shit… this might be the most tasteful & brutal takedown of a category leader i’ve ever seen. & during the fucking super bowl? insane.

usually these things almost always fall flat (see: slack “welcoming” microsoft teams with a fucking newspaper ad & how cringe that was), but this one lands dead center.

even normies will clock the subtlety. the capturing of chatgpt’s drift in personality, tone, & vibes is absolutely unreal. almost surgical. normal ppl i know make fun of how chatgpt talks.

imo openai made themselves vulnerable here by simply trying to do so much (enterprise, codex, consumer, etc) & lacking a singular cohesive narrative other than they have 800m users. like even google is taking shots about openai being forced to run ads.

anyway i’ll post more but this was an absolute master class (i have posted about how openai competitors should handle their ads play, & this is a great start). also i would not count anthropic out of the consumer race yet (they have a lot of room to grow & even potentially acquire small startups).

quoted_tweet.text:
Notice how the headlines work.

A Toyota crashes: "Driver injured in crash."
A Ford crashes: "Two cars collide on highway."
A BMW crashes: "Accident on Route 1."

A Tesla crashes: "TESLA crashes."

Not the driver. Not "a car." The brand, in the headline, every single time.

Millions of crashes happen on the roads every year, and almost none come with a brand name. But when it's a Tesla, legacy media suddenly cares which car it was.

Meanwhile, Tesla publishes its own safety data every quarter. With Autopilot engaged, Teslas go far more miles between crashes than the US average.

That's not journalism. That's a campaign.

The cars keep getting safer. The headlines just keep getting louder.

It says “open source coding models aren’t a complete black box” - which FWIW I think pretty much every real AI researcher I know would agree with.

What's the physical-world analogue?

Introducing Ψ-0.6, one model that reasons in *streams of thought*: words, depth, motion, camera pose, and imagined scenes. And it learns when to use which! 🧵

Are self-evolving LLM agents actually continual learners?

In our new paper, we find that current self-evolving agents remain trapped in a plasticity–stability trade-off when the task distribution drifts.

Many recent recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods rely on rewriting an agent’s own prompts, memory, and code at test time while model weights stay frozen, which works well on stationary benchmarks. In real-world deployments, however, new tasks, tools, and workflows keep arriving, requiring agents to adapt on the fly without forgetting earlier capabilities. To test whether they can learn continually, we evaluate 3 representative methods (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness) across 4 non-stationary task streams built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld (Topic, Workflow, Domain, and Compound drift).

📄 Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25858

避免 worktree 残留的最佳策略是在 AGENTS.md 里面添加规则，要求 worktree 不遗留，让 Agent 自己去清理。

https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/blob/main/AGENTS.md

> worktree 不遗留：在 worktree（含 subagent 的 .claude/worktrees/agent-*）里做的任务，完成时必须删除该 worktree 及其分支。它专用的 cargo target 目录一并删掉。删除前二选一：合并进 main；或不合并时先把未提交改动提交到该分支，打 archive/<worktree 名> tag 存档，再 git worktree remove + git branch -D。编排 subagent 的会话负责收尾它派生的 worktree。确需保留的（待用户裁决、有冲突待解）在最终回复里点名路径与原因，不得默默留下。

EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations

EmbeddingGemma 2 natively unifies text, image, audio, and video into one embedding space, outperforming specialist baselines and models two to twelve times larger on tested benchmarks.

https://arxivb.org/abs/2610.37364

A developer in China named tw93 got tired of his laptop dying.

His desktop was full of apps that were essentially websites bundled with their own browser engine.

Slack. Discord. Notion. Each bringing extra weight.

So he built Pake, a tool that turns webpages into lightweight desktop apps using Rust and Tauri.

Instead of bundling Chromium with every app, it uses the system’s webview.

The examples show the difference in package size:

- Slack: 524 MB → 8 MB
- Discord: 265 MB → 9 MB
- ChatGPT for Windows: 260 MB → 9 MB

Those are download sizes, not RAM measurements. But avoiding a bundled browser makes a substantial difference to the package.

You can use pre-built wrappers or turn a URL into an app with one command.

A small, focused tool for keeping the websites you use in their own desktop windows.

Free and open-source under MIT.

"Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts"

Looped Transformers eventually hit diminishing returns when you loop too much, but MoE sparsity lets models benefit from more loops before performance plateaus.

So Meta researchers introduce Loop Scaling Laws to predict the optimal number of loops and experts for a given compute and memory budget.

And at trillion-token scale, a 1.3B looped MoE matches the reasoning performance of a 2.9B non-looped MoE at similar training compute, achieving roughly 2x parameter efficiency.

https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2609.40316

Excited to introduce CARD 🃏 — Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation.

Almost every method today is limited to kinematics alone as the 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐞 between the human and the robot. With CARD, we track real world contact and forces alongside kinematics to perform unprecedented dexterous tasks through tactile reactive replay!

CARD is scalable:
📹 Multiple input sources
🤖 Multiple robot hands
⚡ needs no object models, no simulator, 10 Hz

BellowsKV: One Latent for Many Layers, Expanded on Demand

BellowsKV stores one shared, quantized hidden latent across adjacent layers instead of separate KV caches, retaining 97-98% accuracy at 13-14x compression across several 7B-8B models.

https://arxivb.org/abs/2610.35023
This is what happens when you can’t just make your own PCBs

创新点：相邻层KV缓存差异大，但隐藏状态高度相似。BellowsKV训练无关，将n层隐藏状态映射到一个全维度共享潜在表示，每层用专属投影重建KV。优先量化（无异常通道，几乎无损）和共享驱逐，而非降维。在Llama-3.1-8B等上，13-14倍压缩仍保留97-98%精度。

数据集：LongBench（Qasper、HotpotQA等长上下文任务）、BrowseComp-Plus（代理检索任务），校准用WikiText-2+代码。
